title: Doughnuts Under a Crescent Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker Uno Hinako works hard at makeup, fashion and dating men so she will seem 'normal', but her attempts at romance keep failing. Her respect for a calm coworker, Asahi Sato, slowly grows into an intimate relationship between the two women. The four-volume yuri series follows adult women working out what kind of closeness they actually want.
life_message: A good life comes from honest self-knowledge and relationships that fit who you are, not from performing what others call normal.

content.note: Quiet office drama; fear of being alone (Wikipedia plot).
Adult same-sex romance at the center (AniList Yuri 93; MU Lesbian/Shoujo Ai); intimacy level to verify; MangaDex safe.
Self-doubt, loneliness and a dead family member (AniList blurb; MU Dead Family Member/s).
Makeup and fashion as a mask for fitting in (AniList blurb).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Conflicts are inner and quiet; no one must defend face or answer insults.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Hinako drops the 'normal' script to choose her own relationship.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Coworker bonds matter more than family marriage expectations.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Relationships between peers at work; little deference to rank.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Custom of marrying a man questioned in favor of personal choice.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Fulfilment and being oneself outrank security or conformity.

folkways.japan: The office-lady setting reflects Japanese workplace expectations that women marry and fit in, which the story describes and gently questions.

delivery.evidence: ANN GN 1 review: handles its social issues without hammering them home; the boss is not drawn as a caricature.

personified.ideology: Closeness on her own terms over performing what is called normal

delivery.note: Pressure to be normal is shown through Hinako's inner struggle and ordinary people around her rather than villains.

winners_losers: Hinako and Asahi win a relationship on their own terms; the pressure to perform 'normal' romance loses. Sympathy goes to authenticity over conformity.
